milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul torches are placed at spawn-relative (3, 0, 4) and (3, 0, 5), marking the building entrance. The player must navigate near them and face toward them to demonstrate they have found the soul torches. Target is set to (3, 0, 5) — the midpoint of the two torches. max_distance=16 allows the player to see the distinctive blue flames from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the torches.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown bed is placed inside the stone brick building at spawn-relative (7, 0, 6) (head) and (8, 0, 6) (foot). The player must enter or approach the building and look toward the bed to demonstrate they have found it. Target is set to (7, 0, 6) which is the bed head block. max_distance=8 requires the player to be close enough to clearly see the bed (inside or at the entrance), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='oak_planks') because this is a build/place task. The player has 64 oak planks in inventory and must place them to build a floor. The check box covers y=0 level (foot/ground level) in a generous area around and outside the building. The existing interior oak_planks floor is at y=-1 (below foot level), so it will NOT be counted in this y=0 check — any oak_planks detected at y=0 must have been newly placed by the player. A minimum of 6 blocks constitutes a meaningful floor section. The box spans from (-5, 0, -2) to (12, 0, 10) spawn-relative to cover the grassy area around the building where the player would logically build a floor.
